items.source: This will produce a RestClient.Builder bean with the prototype scope, meaning each injection point will receive a newly cloned instance of the builder.
items.translation: 这将生成一个 RestClient.Builder 类型的 Bean，其作用域为 prototype`，这意味着每个注入点都会接收到该构建器的一个新克隆实例。
